rules.hpThreshold: Strict pre-hit hp/maxHp below the effect threshold
rules.chance: Sum eligible effects, divide by max(1,endlessFactor/2); zero chance draws no RNG; otherwise roll <= chance
rules.conversion: Triggering hit absorbed, burning removed, hurtbox disabled, pet collision/attack layers, nearest hostile Enemy target
rules.speed: Add 100 source speed points only when current speed is positive
rules.lifetime: Die at timeout; never return to the hostile faction
rules.descendants: Spawned descendants inherit the owner and receive a fresh Charm lifetime
rules.killAttribution: Enemy.player_index remains -1. Friendly hits and timeout deaths have no personal player kill credit; normal non-cleanup death/loot signals still run
rules.healer: Heal players on entering its area, int(1+(wave-1)*0.5); structures are excluded
rules.buffer: One random unboosted player or boostable structure; first timer .25s after spawn (conversion does not reset it), then4s. Player/Turret boosts5s; Mine/Trap marks persist until death.
rules.playerBoostExpiry: Derived from native Player.boost and boost_ended: raw maxHp grant floor(maximum*.2), expiry subtracts current maximum minus before-boost maximum as raw stat. Gain multipliers can leave residual HP stats. Production-module arithmetic tested; not compared in a running Brotato process.
rules.structureBoost: Turret base damage/range/cooldown change before Engineering/Structure stats; Mine already-scaled damage/explosion scale change; DartTrap only marks boosted with no stat change.
rules.bodyCollision: Native PETS_BIT+OBSTACLES_BIT: friendly bodies separate from other pets and obstacles, never from hostile/player bodies; hitboxes still attack hostile hurt circles.
